title: Benchmark verdict record
description: Closed schema for one VerdictRecord produced by board-reader from a fetched benchmark page and validated by vendor-decide. Unknown fields are rejected.

source_id.description: Registry row id for the benchmark page. Stamped from the fetch manifest by vendor-decide.

workload.description: Work type this verdict applies to.

vendor.description: Vendor identifier (for example claude, codex, gemini).

model.description: One of the candidate vendor's current model ids copied verbatim, or null when abstaining or unread.

version.description: Version identifier printed on the page for that model (never a display name), or null.

effort.description: Effort or reasoning level token printed on the page (never a display name), or null.

verdict.description: Relative standing of this vendor on the board for this workload.

error_range.description: True only when the benchmark publishes an error range and a lead lies outside it.

page_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date from a dated row, release column or changelog entry, or null when undated. Stamped from the fetch manifest by vendor-decide.

read.description: Read state of the page. Stamped from the fetch manifest by vendor-decide.

tokens.description: Optional published token usage figure for this candidate on the board (no prices).

unit.description: Token count unit (for example tokens/task, output-tokens/run).

source.description: Board or table label that published the token count.
